name: parabank-api-tests
description: Postman/Newman API test suite for the ParaBank REST API (https://parabank.parasoft.com)

scripts.test: newman run postman/ParaBank_API_Tests.postman_collection.json -e postman/ParaBank.postman_environment.json --folder "01 - Authentication" --folder "02 - Customer Profile" --folder "03 - Accounts" --folder "04 - Money Movement" --folder "05 - Transactions" --folder "06 - Loans" --folder "07 - Investments (Positions)" --reporters cli,junit,htmlextra --reporter-junit-export newman/report.xml --reporter-htmlextra-export newman/report.html
scripts.test:cli: newman run postman/ParaBank_API_Tests.postman_collection.json -e postman/ParaBank.postman_environment.json --folder "01 - Authentication" --folder "02 - Customer Profile" --folder "03 - Accounts" --folder "04 - Money Movement" --folder "05 - Transactions" --folder "06 - Loans" --folder "07 - Investments (Positions)"
scripts.test:admin: newman run postman/ParaBank_API_Tests.postman_collection.json -e postman/ParaBank.postman_environment.json --folder "09 - Admin (DESTRUCTIVE - opt-in only)" --reporters cli
